name: AI Engineer Europe 2027
description: AI engineering conference for developers building agents and LLM apps
note: Conference + workshops + expo, English; early bird tickets announced, prices not published
details: Day 1 has hands-on workshops (separately reserved add-on), community programming and the expo opening; day 2 keynote, technical breakouts and expo; day 3 shortened closing day. 12 tracks across 6 stages with a demo-first expo; speakers not announced yet. Ticket prices and early bird deadline not published. The 2026 edition ran 8-10 April 2026 at the QEII Centre; size 'big' is estimated from the venue and track count.
